WITH earliest AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) AS first_date
    FROM main.payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS earliest_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.customer_id) AS customers,
       COUNT(f.rating) AS rated_rows,
       MIN(p.payment_date) AS earliest_date,
       MAX(p.payment_date) AS latest_first_date
FROM earliest AS e
JOIN main.payment AS p ON p.customer_id = e.customer_id AND p.payment_date = e.first_date
LEFT JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id AND r.customer_id = p.customer_id
LEFT JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
LEFT JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id

arguments.sql:
WITH customer_payments AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) AS total_spent
    FROM main.payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) - 1 AS subsequent_rentals
    FROM main.rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    f.rating AS first_movie_rating,
    AVG(cp.total_spent) AS avg_total_spent,
    AVG(cr.subsequent_rentals) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_payments AS cp
JOIN main.payment AS p
    ON p.customer_id = cp.customer_id
   AND p.payment_date = cp.first_payment_date
JOIN main.rental AS r
    ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
   AND r.customer_id = cp.customer_id
JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN customer_rentals AS cr ON cr.customer_id = cp.customer_id
GROUP BY f.rating
ORDER BY f.rating
LIMIT 1000
